title: Google is rolling out Motion Assist, a feature to reduce motion sickness by showing visual cues on the screen, to Android 17, starting with select Pixel devices (Adamya Sharma/Android Authority)
summary: Adamya Sharma / Android Authority: Google is rolling out Motion Assist, a feature to reduce motion sickness by showing visual cues on the screen, to Android 17, starting with select Pixel devices — Pixel phones appear to be the first devices to get Google's Motion Assist feature. — • … TL;DR
contentText:
Adamya Sharma / Android Authority :

Google is rolling out Motion Assist, a feature to reduce motion sickness by showing visual cues on the screen, to Android 17, starting with select Pixel devices   —  Pixel phones appear to be the first devices to get Google's Motion Assist feature.  —  • … TL;DR
